name: Please remain quiet while the baby sleeps.
trans: 宝宝睡觉时请保持安静。

name: My cat likes to hide among the boxes.
trans: 我的猫喜欢藏在箱子中间。

name: This game will involve a lot of laughing.
trans: 这个游戏会包含很多笑声。

name: My dog is more social than my cat.
trans: 我的狗比我的猫更爱社交。

name: My grandpa loves talking about political stuff.
trans: 我爷爷喜欢谈论政治方面的事情。

name: Are you certain that cats can swim?
trans: 你确定猫会游泳吗？

name: I love pizza, especially with extra cheese.
trans: 我爱比萨，尤其是加了很多奶酪的那种。

name: My little sister is very particular about her shoes.
trans: 我妹妹对自己的鞋子很讲究。

name: The news talked about an economic problem today.
trans: 新闻今天谈到了一个经济问题。

name: A big dog began to approach my chair.
trans: 一只大狗开始靠近我的椅子。

name: My brother claims he never lost the game.
trans: 我哥哥声称他从没输过那场比赛。

name: The quality of this soup is amazing.
trans: 这汤的质量太棒了。

name: I will not miss this opportunity.
trans: 我不会错过这个机会。

name: It rained all day; therefore, we stayed home.
trans: 下了一整天雨，因此我们待在家里。

name: This cake will certainly make you happy.
trans: 这个蛋糕一定会让你开心。

name: Only ten percent of kids like broccoli.
trans: 只有百分之十的孩子喜欢西兰花。

name: I wanted tea, but she brought coffee instead.
trans: 我想要茶，但她却端来了咖啡。

name: She didn't realize her shoes were wet.
trans: 她没有意识到自己的鞋子湿了。

name: Don't mention the broken vase to mom.
trans: 别跟妈妈提那个打碎的花瓶。

name: The kids demand more ice cream now.
trans: 孩子们现在要求更多冰淇淋。

name: What material is this chair made of?
trans: 这把椅子是用什么材料做的？

name: He put a lot of effort into his drawing.
trans: 他在画画上花了很多努力。

name: Please pay attention to the teacher.
trans: 请注意听老师讲课。

name: Upon seeing the cake, the dog jumped up.
trans: 一看到蛋糕，狗就跳了起来。

name: This old house is more than a century old.
trans: 这座老房子已经有一个多世纪的历史了。

name: There is no evidence that cats lie.
trans: 没有证据表明猫会撒谎。

name: My cat is particularly fond of fish.
trans: 我的猫尤其喜欢鱼。

name: I read a funny article this morning.
trans: 我今天早上读了一篇有趣的文章。

name: My parents have some financial worries now.
trans: 我父母现在有一些财务方面的担忧。

name: The school started a campaign against trash.
trans: 学校发起了一场反对垃圾的活动。

name: This flag represents our small town.
trans: 这面旗代表着我们的小镇。

name: I don't know exactly where my keys are.
trans: 我不太确定我的钥匙在哪儿。

name: Music can influence how we feel.
trans: 音乐能够影响我们的感受。

name: Children should respect their grandparents.
trans: 孩子们应该尊重他们的祖父母。

name: This shop sells various kinds of candy.
trans: 这家店卖各种各样的糖果。

name: He forgot his umbrella, thus he got wet.
trans: 他忘了带雨伞，因此被淋湿了。

name: She will attempt to ride the bike alone.
trans: 她打算试着自己骑自行车。

name: My favorite character in the movie is a dog.
trans: 我在电影里最喜欢的角色是一只狗。

name: They worked hard to establish a new club.
trans: 他们努力工作建立了一个新俱乐部。

name: The coach will determine who plays first.
trans: 教练将决定谁先上场。

name: Losing a tooth felt like a significant moment.
trans: 掉一颗牙感觉像是一个重大的时刻。

name: We watched a whole series in one night.
trans: 我们一个晚上看完了整个系列。

name: I didn't recognize you with short hair!
trans: 你剪短发我都没认出你来！

name: My dog seems to gain weight every winter.
trans: 我的狗好像每个冬天都会长肉。

name: My brothers always argue about the remote.
trans: 我哥哥们总是为遥控器争吵。

name: My uncle wears a military uniform to work.
trans: 我叔叔上班穿军装。

name: Despite the rain, we played outside all day.
trans: 尽管下雨，我们还是在外面玩了一整天。

name: Being tall gives you an advantage in basketball.
trans: 身高高在打篮球时是一种优势。

name: You should treat your friends with kindness.
trans: 你应该善待你的朋友们。

name: The sick puppy is getting treatment now.
trans: 那只生病的小狗正在接受治疗。

name: My mom is flying to a conference tomorrow.
trans: 我妈妈明天要飞去参加一个会议。

name: Use your words to express how you feel.
trans: 用你的话来表达你的感受。

name: A wagging tail can indicate a happy dog.
trans: 摇尾巴可以表明狗很开心。

name: Buying that bike was a smart investment.
trans: 买那辆自行车是一笔聪明的投资。

name: This young player has a lot of potential.
trans: 这个年轻球员很有潜力。

name: Plants suffer when you forget to water them.
trans: 你忘记浇水的话植物会很难受。

name: What is your strategy for winning this game?
trans: 你赢这场游戏的策略是什么？

name: Everyone laughed except the grumpy old cat.
trans: 除了那只脾气不好的老猫，大家都笑了。

name: Please pay for the tickets in advance.
trans: 请提前付票钱。

name: Dogs are generally friendlier than cats.
trans: 狗通常比猫更友好。

name: The rescue operation saved three little kittens.
trans: 这次救援行动救了三只小猫。

name: I always associate summer with ice cream.
trans: 我总是把夏天和冰淇淋联系在一起。

name: Try to stay positive after a bad day.
trans: 糟糕的一天过后也要尽量保持积极。

name: For instance, my dog hates loud noises.
trans: 举个例子，我的狗讨厌很大的声音。

name: This word can refer to two things.
trans: 这个词可以指两件事情。

name: Wait, it's already a quarter past six!
trans: 等等，已经六点一刻了！

name: I assumed the store was open today.
trans: 我以为商店今天开门。

name: Her lemonade stand was very successful today.
trans: 她的柠檬水摊今天很成功。

name: I doubt that cat can really talk.
trans: 我怀疑那只猫真的会说话。

name: My sister won first place in the competition.
trans: 我姐姐在比赛中获得了第一名。

name: My little brother has a theory about monsters.
trans: 我弟弟对怪物有一套理论。

name: I propose we eat pizza tonight.
trans: 我提议我们今晚吃比萨。

name: My parents had a small argument about dinner.
trans: 我父母因为晚饭发生了一点小争执。

name: Please sign this document before you leave.
trans: 请在你离开前签这份文件。

name: I like the pattern on your new socks.
trans: 我喜欢你新袜子上的图案。

name: Obviously, the cat ate the fish again.
trans: 显然，猫又把鱼吃了。

name: His plan for the party is still unclear.
trans: 他的派对计划还不清楚。

name: Please keep the cats in separate rooms.
trans: 请把猫分开放在不同的房间里。

name: Our house is close to the central park.
trans: 我们家离中央公园很近。

name: She started her career as a young teacher.
trans: 她的职业生涯是从当一名年轻教师开始的。

name: He gave a short speech at the party.
trans: 他在派对上做了一个简短的演讲。

name: It snowed throughout the whole night.
trans: 整个晚上都在下雪。

name: My little sister wore a pink dress today.
trans: 我小妹妹今天穿了一条粉色连衣裙。

name: The lemonade stand made a small profit.
trans: 柠檬水摊赚了一点小利润。

name: A good coat will protect you from the cold.
trans: 一件好外套能保护你抵御寒冷。

name: This plant has a strange disease on its leaves.
trans: 这株植物的叶子上得了一种奇怪的病。

name: The storm will damage our garden fence.
trans: 暴风雨会损坏我们的花园围栏。

name: We meet every week on a regular basis.
trans: 我们每周都定期见面。

name: This recipe only needs a few basic ingredients.
trans: 这个食谱只需要几种基本材料。

name: My coach always encourages me to try again.
trans: 我的教练总是鼓励我再试一次。

name: This cat is a male, and he loves to nap.
trans: 这只猫是雄性的，它很喜欢打盹。

name: My dad knows how to operate this old machine.
trans: 我爸爸知道怎么操作这台旧机器。

name: The lake reflects the bright moon at night.
trans: 湖面在夜里映出明亮的月光。

name: This old house is my uncle's property.
trans: 这座老房子是我叔叔的财产。

name: My previous phone was much slower than this one.
trans: 我以前的手机比这个慢得多。

name: Can you imagine a dog that can talk?
trans: 你能想象一只会说话的狗吗？

name: She earns money by walking dogs.
trans: 她靠遛狗赚钱。

name: Their daughter just started learning to swim.
trans: 他们的女儿刚开始学游泳。

name: My grandpa reads the newspaper every single morning.
trans: 我爷爷每天早上都看报纸。

name: Can you define this word for me?
trans: 你能给我解释一下这个单词吗？

name: We reached a funny conclusion after the game.
trans: 我们在比赛后得出了一个有趣的结论。

name: Everybody laughs at my dog's silly dance.
trans: 每个人都笑我的狗跳的滑稽舞。

name: My cat loves to perform funny tricks.
trans: 我的猫喜欢表演滑稽的把戏。

name: This chef is more professional than my mom.
trans: 这位厨师比我妈妈更专业。

name: We can debate about the best ice cream flavor.
trans: 我们可以辩论一下最好吃的冰淇淋口味。

name: Please maintain your smile during the whole trip.
trans: 请在整个旅途中保持微笑。

name: I have never gotten credit for cleaning the kitchen.
trans: 我打扫厨房从来没得到过认可。

name: My phone rings loudly every single morning.
trans: 我的手机每天早上都响得很大声。

name: Yesterday we discovered a secret tunnel in the yard.
trans: 昨天我们在院子里发现了一个秘密通道。

name: That broken robot toy is totally dead now.
trans: 那个坏掉的机器人玩具现在完全没电了。

name: You should rest in the afternoon if you're tired.
trans: 如果你累了，应该在下午休息一下。

name: They will extend the party until midnight.
trans: 他们会把派对延长到午夜。

name: This gym has a great facility for swimming.
trans: 这家健身房有很棒的游泳设施。

name: This store sells the biggest variety of candy.
trans: 这家商店卖的糖果种类最多。

name: I completely forgot about my homework again.
trans: 我又把作业完全忘光了。

name: Feeding the dog should be your responsibility.
trans: 喂狗应该是你的责任。

name: Keeping the original recipe is important to grandma.
trans: 保留原始食谱对奶奶来说很重要。

name: My brother will start university next fall.
trans: 我哥哥明年秋天要上大学了。

name: My cat can easily jump over that fence.
trans: 我的猫能轻松跳过那个栅栏。

name: My uncle works at a travel agency downtown.
trans: 我叔叔在市区一家旅行社工作。

name: We planted tomatoes in our garden this spring.
trans: 我们在花园里种了番茄，就在今年春天。

name: She is the best candidate for the job.
trans: 她是这份工作的最佳候选人。

name: It's not legal to keep a pet fox here.
trans: 在这里养宠物狐狸是不合法的。

name: He wrote a long proposal for the new park.
trans: 他为新公园写了一份很长的提案。

name: We had a funny conversation about ghosts last night.
trans: 我们昨晚聊了一场关于鬼的有趣对话。

name: My heart began to pound before the test.
trans: 考试前我的心开始猛烈跳动。

name: She reads a cooking magazine every month.
trans: 她每月都读一本美食杂志。

name: This cloud has a strange shape today.
trans: 这片云今天形状很奇怪。

name: Come here immediately, your soup is getting cold!
trans: 马上过来，你的汤要凉了！

name: You should always welcome new neighbors kindly.
trans: 你应该一直友善地欢迎新邻居。

name: Good communication keeps best friends from fighting.
trans: 良好的沟通能让好朋友们不吵架。

name: My aunt worked as a secret agent once.
trans: 我阿姨曾经当过秘密特工。

name: This dance is more traditional than the new one.
trans: 这个舞蹈比新的那个更传统。

name: You must replace your toothbrush every few months.
trans: 你必须每隔几个月换一次牙刷。

name: Never judge a book by its cover, kids.
trans: 孩子们，永远不要只看封面就评判一本书。

name: Suddenly the lights went out at dinner.
trans: 吃饭的时候灯突然熄灭了。

name: My grandpa is from a generation that loved radio.
trans: 我爷爷来自一个热爱收音机的时代。

name: Can you estimate how tall that giraffe is?
trans: 你能估计一下那只长颈鹿有多高吗？

name: Ice cream is my favorite snack in summer.
trans: 冰淇淋是我夏天最喜欢的零食。

name: She had difficulty catching the fast little mouse.
trans: 她抓那只跑得快的小老鼠很困难。

name: We will purchase tickets for the fun fair.
trans: 我们会为游乐会买票。

name: Please announce the winner before the cake is cut.
trans: 请在切蛋糕前宣布获胜者。

name: Being independent means making your own lunch.
trans: 独立意味着自己做午饭。

name: Can you recommend a fun game for rainy days?
trans: 你能推荐一个雨天玩的好游戏吗？

name: We should survey everyone about the new pizza.
trans: 我们应该调查一下大家对新披萨的看法。

name: The majority of kids chose chocolate over vanilla.
trans: 大多数孩子选了巧克力而不是香草。

name: Stick this note on the fridge for Mom.
trans: 把这张便条贴在冰箱上给妈妈看。

name: He made a silly request for extra dessert.
trans: 他提出了一个想要额外甜点的傻请求。

name: The wind blew his hat off his head.
trans: 风把他的帽子吹掉了。

name: Let's exchange seats so you can see better.
trans: 我们换一下座位吧，这样你能看得更清楚。

name: My budget only allows one ice cream today.
trans: 我今天的预算只够买一个冰淇淋。

name: Wear something appropriate for the wedding.
trans: 穿件适合婚礼的衣服。

name: The crash scene was full of police cars.
trans: 车祸现场到处都是警车。

name: Wash your hands to prevent getting sick.
trans: 洗手可以预防生病。

name: Did you invite your cousin to the party?
trans: 你邀请你表哥来参加派对了吗？

name: Surprise is a key element in magic tricks.
trans: 惊喜是魔术的关键要素。

name: This new soap is really effective against germs.
trans: 这种新肥皂对细菌真的很有效。

name: Please correct my spelling before I send it.
trans: 请在我发送之前改正我的拼写。

name: He needs medical help after the fall.
trans: 他摔倒后需要医疗救助。

name: I must admit, your cooking is amazing.
trans: 我必须承认，你做的菜太棒了。

name: The committee will decide who wins the prize.
trans: 委员会将决定谁赢得奖品。

name: My grandma gave me great advice today.
trans: 我奶奶今天给了我很好的建议。

name: Can you handle this heavy box alone?
trans: 你能自己搬动这个重箱子吗？

name: The new game is still in trial stage.
trans: 这个新游戏还处于试验阶段。

name: This exam puts a lot of stress on me.
trans: 这次考试让我压力很大。

name: The school administration made a new rule today.
trans: 学校行政部门今天出了新规定。

name: This math problem is too complex for me.
trans: 这道数学题对我来说太复杂了。

name: You should talk directly to your mom.
trans: 你应该直接跟你妈妈说。

name: My backpack is heavier than my brother's.
trans: 我的背包比我弟弟的更重。

name: Please remove your shoes before you go in.
trans: 请在进去前脱掉鞋子。

name: The teacher will conduct a fun science test.
trans: 老师将进行一场有趣的科学测试。

name: We bought new equipment for our camping trip.
trans: 我们为露营之旅买了新装备。

name: Eat your veggies, otherwise you won't get dessert.
trans: 吃掉你的蔬菜，不然你就没有甜点吃了。

name: Can I get extra fries with my burger?
trans: 我的汉堡能多加点薯条吗？

name: My dad became a company executive last year.
trans: 我爸爸去年成了公司高管。

name: This chair makes a weird noise when I sit.
trans: 我坐下时这把椅子会发出奇怪的声音。

name: Is that toy really as expensive as a bike?
trans: 那个玩具真的和一辆自行车一样贵吗？

name: The mailman will deliver your birthday gift today.
trans: 邮递员今天会送来你的生日礼物。

name: There's a strange connection between cats and naps.
trans: 猫和打盹之间有一种奇怪的联系。

name: The weather turned rainy during our picnic.
trans: 我们野餐时天气变成了下雨天。

name: You must inform me before eating my cake.
trans: 你吃我的蛋糕之前必须先告诉我。

name: Grandpa taught me a simple life principle.
trans: 爷爷教给我一个简单的生活原则。

name: Walk straight ahead until you see the park.
trans: 一直往前走，直到你看见公园。

name: Loud games appeal to most noisy kids.
trans: 吵闹的游戏对大多数吵闹的孩子有吸引力。

name: She is highly interested in learning piano.
trans: 她对学钢琴非常感兴趣。

name: I trust my dog to protect the house.
trans: 我相信我的狗会保护房子。

name: What a wonderful smell coming from the kitchen!
trans: 厨房飘来的味道真是太棒了！

name: My bike tire went flat this morning.
trans: 我的自行车轮胎今天早上瘪了。

name: This cake is absolutely the best thing ever.
trans: 这个蛋糕绝对是最好吃的东西。

name: We need additional chairs for the party.
trans: 我们还需要一些额外的椅子来办派对。

name: Who is responsible for feeding the fish?
trans: 谁负责喂鱼？

name: My grandpa owns a farm with cows.
trans: 我爷爷有一个养牛的农场。

name: He has a huge collection of toy cars.
trans: 他有一大堆玩具车收藏品。

name: Please hang your coat on the hook.
trans: 请把你的外套挂在挂钩上。

name: Don't be so negative about the weather.
trans: 别对天气这么消极。

name: My brother plays guitar in a band.
trans: 我哥哥在一个乐队里弹吉他。

name: She invited every relative to her birthday.
trans: 她邀请了每一位亲戚来参加她的生日会。

name: We will tour the castle tomorrow morning.
trans: 我们明天早上要去参观那座城堡。

name: Is there an alternative to eating broccoli?
trans: 有没有不吃西兰花的替代办法？

name: This software helps me draw funny pictures.
trans: 这个软件帮我画有趣的图片。

name: The ship moved slowly across the blue sea.
trans: 这艘船缓缓驶过蓝色的大海。

name: He has a great attitude about losing games.
trans: 他对输掉比赛这件事态度很好。

name: This toy looks cheap but it works great.
trans: 这个玩具看起来很便宜，但用起来很好。

name: Scientists observe the stars every night.
trans: 科学家每晚都观察星星。

name: Can you read this sentence out loud?
trans: 你能把这句话大声读出来吗？

name: She has made great progress in swimming.
trans: 她在游泳方面取得了很大进步。

name: Tell me the truth about the broken vase.
trans: 告诉我关于那个打碎花瓶的真相。

name: Nobody wants to clean the messy room.
trans: 没有人想打扫这个乱糟糟的房间。

name: The doctor will examine your sore arm.
trans: 医生会检查你疼痛的手臂。

name: Please lay the blanket on the soft grass.
trans: 请把毯子铺在软草地上。

name: My dad loves talking about politics all the time.
trans: 我爸爸总是喜欢谈论政治。

name: She didn't reply to my letter last night.
trans: 她昨晚没有回复我的信。

name: The store has a cool display in the window.
trans: 那家店的橱窗里有一个很酷的展示。

name: He wants to transfer to a bigger school.
trans: 他想转到一所更大的学校。

name: This cake tastes perfect with ice cream.
trans: 这个蛋糕配冰淇淋吃起来简直完美。

name: My brother is slightly taller than me.
trans: 我哥哥比我稍微高一点。

name: Overall, our trip was a lot of fun.
trans: 总的来说，我们的旅行非常好玩。

name: Do you intend to join the soccer team?
trans: 你打算加入足球队吗？

name: Why didn't you respond to my text?
trans: 你为什么没有回复我的短信？

name: We always eat dinner together on Sundays.
trans: 我们周日总是一起吃晚饭。

name: He takes a regular walk after lunch.
trans: 他午饭后经常散步。

name: This game needs a lot of physical energy.
trans: 这个游戏需要很多体力。

name: Keep your dog apart from the cat tonight.

name: Our main objective is to win this game.
trans: 我们的主要目标是赢得这场比赛。

name: The soup is tasty; moreover, it's cheap.
trans: 这汤很好喝，而且还便宜。

name: Our teacher loves telling historical stories about kings.
trans: 我们老师喜欢讲关于国王的历史故事。

name: Many people oppose cutting down the old trees.
trans: 很多人反对砍掉那些老树。

name: A big branch fell on our car.
trans: 一根大树枝掉在我们车上了。

name: Can you park your vehicle over there?
trans: 你能把车停在那边吗？

name: The scientist mixed two colors and laughed.
trans: 那位科学家混合了两种颜色然后笑了。

name: Let's take the shorter route to school.
trans: 我们走更短的路线去学校吧。

name: Please bind these papers together with string.
trans: 请用绳子把这些纸绑在一起。

name: This old hat belongs to my dad.
trans: 这个旧帽子是我爸爸的。

name: This soup has a really spicy taste.
trans: 这汤的味道真辣。

name: We are watching a movie tonight.
trans: 我们今晚要看电影。

name: She always dresses in the latest fashion.
trans: 她总是穿最新潮的衣服。

name: Swimming alone in the sea is a danger.
trans: 独自在海里游泳很危险。

name: The movie had a huge bomb scene.
trans: 这部电影有一个巨大的炸弹场景。

name: His older brother joined the army last year.
trans: 他哥哥去年参军了。

name: That road is more dangerous than this one.
trans: 那条路比这条更危险。

name: Sales usually decrease during the cold winter.
trans: 销量通常在寒冬时下降。

name: Did you hurt your knee playing football?
trans: 你踢足球的时候伤到膝盖了吗？

name: The town council meets every Monday morning.
trans: 镇议会每周一早上开会。

name: I normally wake up before my alarm rings.
trans: 我通常在闹钟响之前就醒了。

name: The sunset was a beautiful sight yesterday.
trans: 昨天的日落景色真美。

name: This machine can generate a lot of noise.
trans: 这台机器会发出很多噪音。

name: The delivery has just arrived at our door.
trans: 快递刚刚送到我们家门口。

name: She wants to deny eating the last cookie.
trans: 她想否认偷吃了最后一块饼干。

name: We will have a special guest for dinner.
trans: 我们晚餐会邀请一位特别的客人。

name: Is anybody home right now, Mom?
trans: 妈妈，现在家里有人吗？

name: My bedroom window faces a green park.
trans: 我的卧室窗户对着一个绿色的公园。

name: He loves quoting funny lines from old movies.
trans: 他喜欢引用电影里有趣的台词。

name: Climb up the tree before it gets dark!
trans: 天黑之前快爬上那棵树！

name: Basically, we just watched cartoons all day long.
trans: 基本上，我们一整天都在看卡通片。

name: The movie had violence that scared the kids.
trans: 那部电影有暴力场面，吓到了孩子们。

name: The minister speaks to everyone every Sunday morning.
trans: 那位牧师每个周日早上都会讲话。

name: We mainly ate rice and eggs last night.
trans: 昨晚我们主要吃了米饭和鸡蛋。

name: Don't talk with food inside your mouth!
trans: 嘴里有食物的时候别说话！

name: The waiter who smiled had a kind manner.
trans: 那个微笑的服务员态度很好。

name: We will meet at the square after lunch.
trans: 我们午饭后会在广场见面。

name: We have never had such a fun occasion.
trans: 我们从来没有过这么好玩的场合。

name: This song feels more familiar than the last one.
trans: 这首歌比上一首更让人熟悉。

name: You should not ignore your mom's phone calls.
trans: 你不应该忽视你妈妈的电话。

name: A big storm could destroy our garden fence.
trans: 一场大风暴可能会毁掉我们的花园围栏。

name: This whole affair is none of your business.
trans: 这整件事跟你没关系。

name: The civil war lasted for many long years.
trans: 那场内战持续了很多年。

name: Can you help me locate my missing shoe?
trans: 你能帮我找到我丢的鞋吗？

name: Every citizen must follow the basic laws.
trans: 每个公民都必须遵守基本法律。

name: The temperature dropped fast last night.
trans: 昨晚气温骤降。

name: She won a shiny gold medal yesterday.
trans: 她昨天赢得了一枚闪亮的金牌。

name: Our cat is a very lazy domestic animal.
trans: 我们的猫是一只很懒的家养动物。

name: His belief in magic never really changed.
trans: 他对魔法的信念从没真正变过。

name: A troop of monkeys ran across the road.
trans: 一群猴子跑过了马路。

name: This game has some tricky technical problems.
trans: 这个游戏有些棘手的技术问题。

name: Please remind me to feed the fish.
trans: 请提醒我去喂鱼。

name: We made a fun arrangement for the party.
trans: 我们为派对做了个有趣的安排。

name: My skin feels dry after swimming all day.
trans: 游了一天泳后我的皮肤感觉很干。

name: The thief was sent to prison last week.
trans: 那个小偷上周被送进了监狱。

name: Could you switch on the light, please?
trans: 你能把灯打开吗？

name: He hopes to acquire a new puppy soon.
trans: 他希望很快能得到一只新小狗。

name: She works for a huge corporate company downtown.
trans: 她在市中心一家大型企业公司工作。

name: This cake tastes fairly good, don't you think?
trans: 这个蛋糕味道相当不错，你不觉得吗？

name: Dad is cutting wood for the fireplace.
trans: 爸爸在为壁炉砍木头。

name: Will you participate in the school race?
trans: 你会参加学校的比赛吗？

name: This bread is tougher than an old shoe.
trans: 这面包比一只旧鞋还硬。

name: Please don't tear my favorite book!
trans: 请别撕坏我最喜欢的书！

name: He was chosen as our team representative.
trans: 他被选为我们团队的代表。

name: This stadium has a bigger capacity than ours.
trans: 这个体育场的容量比我们的大。

name: Mexico shares a long border with the US.
trans: 墨西哥和美国有一条很长的边界。

name: I will shake the bottle before I drink it.
trans: 我喝之前会先摇一摇瓶子。

name: Did you finish your math assessment yet?
trans: 你做完数学测评了吗？

name: This shoe is too tight for my foot.
trans: 这只鞋对我的脚来说太紧了。

name: You ought to drink more water daily.
trans: 你应该每天多喝水。

name: Paying the entrance fee was totally worth it.
trans: 付入场费真的很值得。

name: We danced all night in the big hall.
trans: 我们在大厅里跳了一整晚舞。

name: It's hard to follow every new regulation.
trans: 遵守每一项新规定都很难。

name: The bird has escaped from its cage.
trans: 那只鸟从笼子里逃出来了。

name: My friend paints pictures in her tiny studio.
trans: 我朋友在她的小工作室里画画。

name: You should use proper manners at dinner.
trans: 吃晚饭时你应该用恰当的礼仪。

name: Just relax and watch your favorite movie.
trans: 放松一下，看看你最喜欢的电影。

name: This is the most popular spot for tourists.
trans: 这是游客最喜欢的地方。

name: The toy broke because one component was missing.
trans: 这个玩具坏了，因为少了一个零件。

name: Can we afford a trip to Hawaii?
trans: 我们能负担得起去夏威夷的旅行吗？

name: My sister wants to become a lawyer.
trans: 我姐姐想成为一名律师。

name: I suspect my brother hid my candy.
trans: 我怀疑我弟弟把我的糖藏起来了。

name: Please give a short description of your dog.
trans: 请简单描述一下你的狗。

name: She answers every question with great confidence.
trans: 她回答每个问题都很有信心。

name: This small town has many industrial buildings.
trans: 这个小镇有很多工业建筑。

name: My neighbor always complains about the loud music.
trans: 我邻居总是抱怨那吵闹的音乐。

name: Try to see this problem from your mom's perspective.
trans: 试着从你妈妈的角度看这个问题。

name: The police will arrest the thief tonight.
trans: 警察今晚会逮捕那个小偷。

name: The doctor must assess your knee injury first.
trans: 医生必须先评估你的膝伤。

name: You should register before the class starts.
trans: 上课前你应该先注册。

name: Our silly dog is a real asset to the family.
trans: 我们家那只傻狗真是个宝。

name: That old story isn't relevant to our plan.
trans: 那个旧故事和我们的计划无关。

name: Let's explore the old castle this weekend.
trans: 我们这周末去探索那座旧城堡吧。

name: Good leadership helped our team win the game.
trans: 出色的领导力帮我们球队赢了比赛。

name: Marriage needs a strong commitment from both people.
trans: 婚姻需要两个人共同的承诺。

name: Being rich doesn't necessarily mean being happy.
trans: 富有不一定意味着快乐。

name: The moon looks really bright tonight.
trans: 今晚月亮看起来特别明亮。

name: I put my cat's photo in a tiny frame.
trans: 我把我猫的照片放进一个小框里。

name: We share a close bond with our new puppy.
trans: 我们和新来的小狗有很深的感情纽带。

name: The doctor checked for any internal injuries.
trans: 医生检查了是否有内部损伤。

name: She wears a gold chain around her neck.
trans: 她脖子上戴着一条金链子。

name: He studies English literature at his college.
trans: 他在大学学习英国文学。

name: The mouse became a victim of our cat's games.
trans: 老鼠成了我们猫咪游戏的受害者。

name: Dark clouds threaten to ruin our picnic.
trans: 乌云威胁着要毁掉我们的野餐。

name: Our class splits into two divisions for games.
trans: 我们班分成两个部分来做游戏。

name: Make sure the ladder is secure before climbing.
trans: 爬之前确保梯子是牢固的。

name: Your magic tricks always amaze my little brother.
trans: 你的魔术总是让我弟弟惊讶。

name: This device charges my phone in minutes.
trans: 这个装置几分钟就能给我手机充电。

name: We got lost in a dark forest yesterday.
trans: 我们昨天在一片黑森林里迷路了。

name: My uncle works at a toy factory.
trans: 我叔叔在一家玩具工厂工作。

name: Buying candy every day is a silly expense.
trans: 每天买糖果是一笔愚蠢的花费。

name: Can you change the channel to cartoons?
trans: 你能把频道换到卡通片吗？

name: The police will investigate who broke the window.
trans: 警察将调查是谁打破了窗户。

name: My teacher gave me a nice recommendation letter.
trans: 我老师给了我一封很好的推荐信。

name: What rank did you get in the game?
trans: 你在游戏里获得了什么等级？

name: A typical morning starts with toast and juice.
trans: 典型的早晨从吐司和果汁开始。

name: Our new neighbor is really friendly and kind.
trans: 我们的新邻居非常友好又善良。

name: Every resident must park in the correct spot.
trans: 每位居民都必须停在正确的车位。

name: We packed food provisions for the long trip.
trans: 我们为长途旅行准备了食物储备。

name: I need quiet to concentrate on my homework.
trans: 我需要安静才能专心做作业。

name: We have plenty of pizza for everyone tonight.
trans: 今晚我们有足够的披萨给大家吃。

name: This country exports tons of coffee beans.
trans: 这个国家出口大量咖啡豆。

name: The cake is entirely gone now.
trans: 蛋糕现在完全没了。

name: I strongly believe my dog is a genius.
trans: 我强烈相信我的狗是个天才。

name: We walked across the old bridge together.
trans: 我们一起走过那座旧桥。

name: This soup consists of noodles and veggies.
trans: 这锅汤由面条和蔬菜组成。

name: My cousin will graduate next summer.
trans: 我表哥明年夏天就要毕业了。

name: This brand makes my favorite sneakers.
trans: 这个牌子生产我最喜欢的运动鞋。

name: Who knows the moral of this story?
trans: 谁知道这个故事的寓意？

name: My mom insists on cleaning my room.
trans: 我妈妈坚持要打扫我的房间。

name: I forgot the combination to my lock.
trans: 我忘了锁的密码组合。

name: Please don't abuse your power at home.
trans: 请不要在家里滥用你的权力。

name: Our principal visited every classroom today.
trans: 我们的校长今天参观了每间教室。

name: He wants to master cooking fried rice.
trans: 他想精通炒饭的做法。

name: I will definitely eat that whole pizza.
trans: 我一定会把那整个比萨吃掉。

name: Our training session starts at noon.
trans: 我们的培训课程中午开始。

name: What grade did you get on the test?
trans: 你这次考试得了什么等级？

name: It rained; nevertheless, we played outside.
trans: 下雨了，尽管如此我们还是在外面玩。

name: Can you predict who will win the game?
trans: 你能预测谁会赢这场比赛吗？

name: I previously lived in a small town.
trans: 我以前住在一个小镇上。

name: This jacket gives good protection from rain.
trans: 这件夹克能很好地防雨。

name: The trip was largely about eating snacks.
trans: 这次旅行主要就是吃零食。

name: My cousin will wed her boyfriend next spring.
trans: 我表姐明年春天要嫁给她男朋友。

name: We rent a tiny house near the beach.
trans: 我们在海边租了一间小房子。

name: His sudden appearance scared the whole family.
trans: 他突然出现吓到了全家人。

name: Is this price reasonable for a used bike?
trans: 这辆二手自行车的价格合理吗？

name: The shop gave us a guarantee for the toy.
trans: 那家店给这个玩具提供了保证。

name: What is the theme of your birthday party?
trans: 你生日派对的主题是什么？

name: Trust your own judgment when picking a movie.
trans: 选电影时要相信自己的判断。

name: Seven is an odd number, not even.
trans: 七是奇数，不是偶数。

name: My mom didn't approve of my new haircut.
trans: 我妈不赞成我的新发型。

name: He has taken out a loan for his car.
trans: 他贷款买了一辆车。

name: Can you give me the definition of this word?
trans: 你能告诉我这个词的定义吗？

name: We will elect a new class leader tomorrow.
trans: 我们明天要选一个新班长。

name: The party had a really fun atmosphere.
trans: 这个派对气氛特别有趣。

name: My grandpa is a farmer who grows corn.
trans: 我爷爷是个种玉米的农民。

name: There's no comparison between my cooking and yours.
trans: 我做的菜和你做的根本没法比。

name: Being brave is a characteristic of my dog.
trans: 勇敢是我家狗狗的特点。

name: You need a license to drive this truck.
trans: 开这辆卡车需要驾照。

name: I always rely on my sister for advice.
trans: 我总是依靠我姐姐给我建议。

name: You can't fit two cars on this narrow road.
trans: 这条窄路放不下两辆车。

name: The spy hid his real identity for years.
trans: 那个间谍隐藏了真实身份很多年。

name: My mom won't permit me to skip school.
trans: 我妈妈不会允许我逃学。

name: Please take your homework seriously tonight.
trans: 今晚请认真对待你的作业。

name: The wild monkeys steal our bananas every day.
trans: 那些野猴子每天都偷我们的香蕉。

name: The artist has earned a nice commission already.
trans: 那位艺术家已经赚到了一笔不错的佣金。

name: She owns a unique phone case that glows.
trans: 她有一个会发光的独特手机壳。

name: He will join an association for young writers.
trans: 他将加入一个青年作家协会。

name: Can you play any musical instrument well?
trans: 你会熟练演奏什么乐器吗？

name: The investor bought shares in our bakery.
trans: 那位投资者买了我们面包店的股份。

name: Wearing boots is more practical than sandals.
trans: 穿靴子比穿凉鞋更实用。

name: Spending your youth outdoors sounds amazing.
trans: 在户外度过你的青春听起来很棒。

name: My expectation was that dinner would be ready.
trans: 我原本期待晚饭已经准备好了。

name: He has found employment at the new bakery.
trans: 他已经在新面包店找到了工作。

name: Let's celebrate your birthday with pizza!
trans: 我们用披萨庆祝你的生日吧！

name: The teacher explains sexual health every year.
trans: 老师每年都会讲解性健康知识。

name: The cat jumped onto my shoulder suddenly.
trans: 那只猫突然跳到了我的肩膀上。

name: Take a deep breath before you dive.
trans: 跳水之前先深呼吸一下。

name: Our dog is becoming increasingly lazy lately.
trans: 我们的狗最近变得越来越懒了。

name: Please pass me that water bottle.
trans: 请把那个水瓶递给我。

name: We made dinner by ourselves tonight.
trans: 我们今晚自己做了晚饭。

name: Grab a clean sheet of paper.
trans: 拿一张干净的纸。

name: The car's engine made a weird noise today.
trans: 这辆车的发动机今天发出奇怪的声音。

name: The fisherman cast his net into the lake.
trans: 渔夫把网投进了湖里。

name: You should drop that silly notion right now.
trans: 你现在应该放弃那个傻念头。

name: My uncle is more conservative than my aunt.
trans: 我叔叔比我阿姨更保守。

name: We will start our journey before sunrise.
trans: 我们将在日出前开始旅程。

name: Did you feel any opposition from your team?
trans: 你从你的团队感受到任何反对吗？

name: I have felt such relief since the exam ended.
trans: 考试结束后我感到如此宽慰。

name: Paying off debt feels really good.
trans: 还清债务的感觉真好。

name: Please honor your promise to your sister.
trans: 请遵守你对妹妹的承诺。

name: She smiled because the outcome was so good.
trans: 她笑了，因为结果很好。

name: The kid who broke the vase got the blame.
trans: 打碎花瓶的那个孩子受到了责怪。

name: He gave a strange explanation for being late.
trans: 他对迟到给出了一个奇怪的解释。

name: New problems often arise during long trips.
trans: 长途旅行中常常会出现新问题。

name: This song is more musical than the last one.
trans: 这首歌比上一首更悦耳。

name: My dog has recovered from its small cold.
trans: 我的狗从小感冒中恢复了。

name: Is your dad coming to the picnic today?
trans: 你爸爸今天会来野餐吗？

name: Stretch your arms before you start running.
trans: 跑步前先伸展一下手臂。

name: The teacher declared today a fun movie day.
trans: 老师宣布今天是有趣的电影日。

name: My grandpa will retire next summer finally.
trans: 我爷爷明年夏天终于要退休了。

name: I noticed that the kitten is really tiny.
trans: 我注意到这只小猫真的很小。

name: Please be careful with that hot soup.
trans: 小心那碗热汤。

name: This jacket isn't suitable for winter.
trans: 这件外套不适合冬天穿。

name: She speaks French like a native.
trans: 她说法语就像本地人一样。

name: We should eat more fruit every day.
trans: 我们应该每天多吃水果。

name: Can you analyze why the cake fell?
trans: 你能分析一下蛋糕为什么塌了吗？

name: My cat was the only witness to the mess.
trans: 我的猫是这场混乱唯一的目击者。

name: I need to mail this letter today.
trans: 我今天需要把这封信寄出去。

name: The weather was terrible last weekend.
trans: 上周末天气很糟糕。

name: My uncle works as a researcher at school.
trans: 我叔叔在学校当研究员。

name: It was just an ordinary boring day.
trans: 这只是一个普通无聊的日子。

name: The shop has a huge selection of candy.
trans: 那家店有一大堆糖果可以选。

name: You can sit anywhere you like.
trans: 你可以随便坐在任何地方。

name: Playing chess is good for mental health.
trans: 下棋对心理健康有好处。

name: Every participant got a free prize.
trans: 每位参加者都得到了一份免费奖品。

name: Grandma's vision isn't as sharp anymore.
trans: 奶奶的视力不像以前那么好了。

name: My dog has a really funny personality.
trans: 我的狗性格真的很好笑。

name: I asked specifically for no onions.
trans: 我特意要求不要放洋葱。

name: Did you see the entry fee for the park?
trans: 你看到公园的入场费了吗？

name: He is a kind fellow who helps everyone.
trans: 他是个帮助每个人的好人。

name: Don't mix that chemical with water.
trans: 别把那种化学品和水混在一起。

name: The photo will capture this funny moment.
trans: 这张照片会捕捉到这个有趣的瞬间。

name: Can you give me a tip for cooking rice?
trans: 你能给我一个煮米饭的小窍门吗？

name: The store gave us a big discount today.
trans: 商店今天给了我们很大的折扣。

name: We finally reached the peak of the mountain.
trans: 我们终于到达了山的最高点。

name: My uncle became chairman of the club.
trans: 我叔叔成了俱乐部的主席。

name: Add sugar in the right proportion please.
trans: 请按合适的比例加糖。

name: My dog has one black ear.
trans: 我的狗有一只黑耳朵。

name: The cookies disappear whenever my brother visits.
trans: 每次我哥哥来，饼干就会消失。

name: Don't shout, the baby is sleeping.
trans: 别喊，宝宝在睡觉呢。

name: The kids are playing in the yard.
trans: 孩子们在院子里玩。

name: His phone makes a constant annoying sound.
trans: 他的手机一直发出讨厌的声音。

name: Her cooking has improved significantly this year.
trans: 她的厨艺今年有了显著的提高。

name: We rolled down the grassy hill laughing.
trans: 我们笑着从草地山坡上滚下来。

name: He spent a considerable amount of time eating.
trans: 他花了相当多的时间吃东西。

name: Please read the instruction before you start.
trans: 开始之前请先读说明。

name: That parrot has surprising intelligence, honestly.
trans: 说实话，那只鹦鹉有惊人的智力。

name: This weather is ideal for a picnic.
trans: 这天气特别适合野餐。

name: My grandma loves singing old folk songs.
trans: 我奶奶喜欢唱古老的民谣。

name: You will surely enjoy this chocolate cake.
trans: 你肯定会喜欢这块巧克力蛋糕。

name: Our dog guards the house every night.
trans: 我们家的狗每晚都守护房子。

name: My cat always sleeps on my laptop.
trans: 我的猫总是睡在我的笔记本电脑上。

name: The soup tastes somewhat spicy today.
trans: 这汤今天尝起来稍微有点辣。

name: She gave her baby a sweet kiss.
trans: 她给宝宝甜甜地吻了一下。

name: Did you finish your presentation for tomorrow?
trans: 你明天的报告准备好了吗？

name: We planned a joint birthday party together.
trans: 我们一起策划了一个联合生日派对。

name: Two teams will compete this weekend.
trans: 两支队伍这个周末将要比赛。

name: The poll shows most kids love pizza.
trans: 民意调查显示大多数孩子喜欢披萨。

name: I have faith that we will win.
trans: 我相信我们一定会赢。

name: The store gave us a nice reduction.
trans: 商店给了我们一个不错的折扣。

name: Please reserve a table for dinner.
trans: 请帮我预订一张晚餐的桌子。

name: You should write your complaint here.
trans: 你应该把你的投诉写在这里。

name: This long movie really bores me.
trans: 这部长长的电影真让我厌烦。

name: This is the mission that scares me most.
trans: 这就是最让我害怕的任务。

name: Somehow my dog opened the fridge again.
trans: 不知怎么的，我的狗又打开了冰箱。

name: Her voice had a very calm tone.
trans: 她的声音带着非常平静的语调。

name: Everyone in our neighborhood knows my dog.
trans: 我们街区里每个人都认识我的狗。

name: The bus has only one passenger today.
trans: 今天公共汽车上只有一位乘客。

name: The judge believes in true justice.
trans: 这位法官相信真正的正义。

name: We are entering a new phase now.
trans: 我们现在正进入一个新阶段。

name: This ice looks too thin to skate on.
trans: 这冰看起来太薄了，没法滑冰。

name: We must rush home before the storm starts.
trans: 我们得在暴风雨来之前赶紧回家。

name: Wear something formal for the dinner party.
trans: 参加晚宴要穿正式一点的衣服。

name: Her religion means a lot to her family.
trans: 她的宗教信仰对她家人很重要。

name: My employer gave us Friday off this week.
trans: 我老板这周给我们周五放假。

name: Don't reject the cookie I baked for you.
trans: 别拒绝我给你烤的饼干。

name: I like cats and dogs, but prefer the latter.
trans: 我喜欢猫和狗，但更喜欢后者。

name: Put the pizza on a clean plate please.
trans: 请把披萨放在干净的盘子上。

name: The school will ban phones during lunch.
trans: 学校将在午餐时间禁止使用手机。

name: The sneaky cat tried to steal my fish.
trans: 那只狡猾的猫想偷我的鱼。

name: Students held a protest outside the building today.
trans: 学生们今天在楼外举行了抗议活动。

name: My brother frequently forgets his own birthday.
trans: 我弟弟经常忘记自己的生日。

name: Draw a circle around the correct answer.
trans: 在正确答案周围画一个圆圈。

name: The dog finally obeyed my simple command.
trans: 那只狗终于听从了我简单的命令。

name: That new jacket looks really attractive on you.
trans: 那件新夹克穿在你身上真的很有魅力。

name: You made a great impression at the interview.
trans: 你在面试中留下了很好的印象。

name: This toy needs an electronic chip to work.
trans: 这个玩具需要一个电子芯片才能工作。

name: Please don't impose your rules on me.
trans: 请别把你的规矩强加给我。

name: The movie showed a criminal stealing jewels.
trans: 电影里展示了一个罪犯偷珠宝。

name: Besides pizza, what else do you want?
trans: 除了披萨，你还想要别的吗？

name: Chew your food properly before you swallow.
trans: 吃东西前要好好咀嚼再吞下去。

name: This temple is really ancient and cool.
trans: 这座寺庙真的很古老又很酷。

name: We drove along the coast all day.
trans: 我们沿着海岸开了一整天车。

name: Watch the cat closely, it might jump.
trans: 仔细看着这只猫，它可能会跳。

name: Does she have multiple pets at home?
trans: 她家里养了好几只宠物吗？

name: The old bridge might yield under weight.
trans: 这座旧桥可能承受不住重量而塌陷。

name: She sent the letter via her brother.
trans: 她通过她哥哥寄了这封信。

name: This legislation will protect many animals.
trans: 这项法律将保护许多动物。

name: My aunt lives in a quiet county.
trans: 我阿姨住在一个安静的县里。

name: Is your mobile phone very expensive?
trans: 你的手机很贵吗？

name: My assistant has brought me coffee twice.
trans: 我的助理已经给我端过两次咖啡了。

name: We should implement this plan soon.
trans: 我们应该尽快实施这个计划。

name: Check this chart before you leave.
trans: 离开之前看看这张图表。

name: Can you attach the photo now?
trans: 你现在能把照片附上吗？

name: My dog follows me everywhere I go.
trans: 我走到哪里，我的狗都跟着我。

name: You should always advise your friends kindly.
trans: 你应该总是善意地给朋友建议。

name: Which household has the biggest dog?
trans: 哪家人养的狗最大？

name: He never acknowledges his own mistakes.
trans: 他从不承认自己的错误。

name: Give the dog a reward for sitting.
trans: 给这只狗一个奖励，因为它坐好了。

name: Her academic skills are better than mine.
trans: 她的学术能力比我强。

name: Every voter must bring a card.
trans: 每个选民都必须带卡片。

name: I cooked dinner; meanwhile, my cat slept.
trans: 我做晚饭的时候，我的猫在睡觉。

name: Furthermore, we should bring more snacks.
trans: 此外，我们应该多带点零食。

name: She accused her brother of stealing cookies.
trans: 她指责她弟弟偷了饼干。

name: She loves scientific shows about space and stars.
trans: 她喜欢关于太空和星星的科学节目。

name: His first wage was higher than expected.
trans: 他第一份工资比预期的高。

name: Why was your absence so long last week?
trans: 你上周为什么缺席这么久？

name: They will construct a tall tower next year.
trans: 他们明年将建造一座高塔。

name: He made a funny remark about my hat.
trans: 他对我的帽子说了句搞笑的话。

name: Taking medicine on time can help you feel better.
trans: 按时吃药能让你感觉好一点。

name: The professor who teaches math is really kind.
trans: 教数学的那个教授真的很友善。

name: Finding a pink elephant is extremely rare.
trans: 找到一只粉色大象非常罕见。

name: What is your intention for visiting so late?
trans: 你这么晚来访的意图是什么？

name: I bought a dozen eggs for breakfast today.
trans: 我今天买了一打鸡蛋做早餐。

name: Reaching a settlement took much longer than planned.
trans: 达成和解比计划的时间长得多。

name: This game is widely played by kids everywhere.
trans: 这个游戏到处都有孩子在玩。

name: You must pay the minimum amount today.
trans: 你今天必须支付最低金额。

name: We are traveling to the northern part of town.
trans: 我们正在前往城镇的北部。

name: My uncle owns a huge estate near the lake.
trans: 我叔叔在湖边拥有一大片地产。

name: We should divide the pizza equally for everyone.
trans: 我们应该把披萨平均分给每个人。

name: Don't expose your skin to the hot sun.
trans: 别让你的皮肤暴露在炎热的太阳下。

name: My goldfish is still alive after a week.
trans: 我的金鱼一周后还活着。

name: Shut the window before it rains.
trans: 下雨前把窗户关上。

name: Our team won a great victory yesterday.
trans: 我们队昨天赢得了一场大胜利。

name: I will resolve this mess by tonight.
trans: 我今晚之前会解决这个烂摊子。

name: The critic who reviewed it was harsh.
trans: 那个评论它的批评家很苛刻。

name: Her mood is pretty variable these days.
trans: 她这些天的心情很多变。

name: Have you ever seen such an enormous cake?
trans: 你见过这么巨大的蛋糕吗？

name: This candy is sweeter than that one.
trans: 这块糖比那块更甜。

name: You must find a permanent solution now.
trans: 你现在必须找到一个永久的解决办法。

name: Showing emotion isn't always easy for him.
trans: 表达情感对他来说并不总是容易的。

name: She decided to pursue her dream job.
trans: 她决定去追求她梦想的工作。

name: I urge you to eat your veggies.
trans: 我极力劝你吃掉你的蔬菜。

name: He became my enemy because he lied.
trans: 他因为撒谎而变成了我的敌人。

name: They appointed him as the new captain.
trans: 他们任命他为新队长。

name: You can see her talent on stage.
trans: 你能在舞台上看到她的天赋。

name: This soup smells amazing right now.
trans: 这汤现在闻起来太香了。

name: I have a prior meeting this morning.
trans: 我今天早上有个之前约好的会议。

name: Sleep should be your top priority tonight.
trans: 睡眠应该是你今晚的首要任务。

name: My brother is always online gaming.
trans: 我哥哥总是在线上玩游戏。

name: Learn the phrase which means good luck.
trans: 学一下意思是“好运”的那个短语。

name: The pilot landed the plane very carefully.
trans: 飞行员非常小心地降落了飞机。

name: My little pony has a calm, stable temper.
trans: 我的小马性情平静又稳定。

name: I merely wanted a hug from you.
trans: 我只是想要你抱一下。

name: My resolution this year is sleeping more.
trans: 我今年的决心是多睡觉。

name: Dolphins can communicate through clicks and whistles.
trans: 海豚能通过咔嗒声和口哨声交流。

name: He has a small injury from running today.
trans: 他今天跑步时受了点小伤。

name: The desert looks vast from up here.
trans: 从这儿看沙漠显得很辽阔。

name: Let's visit the new art exhibition tomorrow.
trans: 我们明天去看新的艺术展览吧。

name: She will become a famous movie producer.
trans: 她将成为一位著名的电影制片人。

name: This is the regional food that my mom loves.
trans: 这是我妈妈喜欢的地方特色美食。

name: Can you give me an immediate answer?
trans: 你能马上给我一个答复吗？

name: We left early because of a strange incident.
trans: 因为一件奇怪的事件，我们提前离开了。

name: I had a happy childhood near the sea.
trans: 我在海边度过了快乐的童年。

name: Writing a good draft takes a lot of patience.
trans: 写一份好草稿需要很多耐心。

name: Watch out, you might slip on the ice!
trans: 小心点，你可能会在冰上滑倒！

name: I will accompany you to the dentist.
trans: 我会陪你去看牙医。

name: The politician who visited us seemed nice.
trans: 那位来拜访我们的政治家看起来很友善。

name: My cat gets angrier than my dog.
trans: 我的猫比我的狗更容易生气。

name: Someone is knocking on our door right now.
trans: 现在有人在敲我们的门。

name: Does your new job pay a good salary?
trans: 你的新工作薪水好吗？

name: Can you illustrate how this toy works?
trans: 你能说明一下这个玩具怎么用吗？

name: Her quiet answer seemed to imply she was sad.
trans: 她安静的回答似乎暗示她很难过。

name: We eat pancakes for breakfast every Sunday.
trans: 我们每周日早餐吃煎饼。

name: This job is only temporary, not forever.
trans: 这份工作只是临时的，不是永久的。

name: My teacher has very liberal views about homework.
trans: 我的老师对作业的看法很开明。

name: We swam in the lake all afternoon.
trans: 我们整个下午都在湖里游泳。

name: You must practice hard to qualify for the team.
trans: 你必须努力练习才能有资格进入这个队。

name: This market is becoming more competitive every year.
trans: 这个市场每年竞争越来越激烈。

name: I truly love spending time with my dog.
trans: 我真的很喜欢和我的狗待在一起。

name: The movie made everyone in the room emotional.
trans: 这部电影让房间里的每个人都动情了。

name: The aircraft can fly very high in the sky.
trans: 这架飞机能在天空中飞得很高。

name: This bridge is made of strong metal.
trans: 这座桥是用坚固的金属做的。

name: This tiny bug has a very short existence.
trans: 这只小虫子的生命非常短暂。

name: My dog is chewing a big bone now.
trans: 我的狗现在在嚼一根大骨头。

name: Press the button on the control panel.
trans: 按一下控制面板上的按钮。

name: Summer is the prime time for ice cream.
trans: 夏天是吃冰淇淋的最佳时节。

name: Do you have an appointment with the doctor?
trans: 你和医生有预约吗？

name: Let me emphasize how important sleep is.
trans: 让我强调一下睡觉有多重要。

name: The maximum speed here is forty miles.
trans: 这里的最高速度是四十英里。

name: This new soap cleans your hands more effectively.
trans: 这种新肥皂洗手更有效。

name: My keys aren't here, so they must be elsewhere.
trans: 我的钥匙不在这儿，一定在别的地方。

name: Please don't bother me while I'm sleeping.
trans: 我睡觉的时候请别打扰我。

name: She took the initiative to clean the kitchen.
trans: 她主动把厨房打扫了一遍。

name: Be careful, that knife is really sharp.
trans: 小心，那把刀真的很锋利。

name: My dog's diet is just chicken and rice.
trans: 我家狗的日常饮食就是鸡肉和米饭。

name: He made a funny motion with his hand.
trans: 他用手做了个有趣的动作。

name: My grandpa's hair turned gray last year.
trans: 我爷爷的头发去年变灰白了。

name: This toy is made of cheap plastic.
trans: 这个玩具是用廉价塑料做的。

name: Don't complicate things, just answer yes or no.
trans: 别把事情搞复杂，直接回答是或不是。

name: Soccer players need a lot of discipline.
trans: 足球运动员需要很强的自律。

name: I don't want to disappoint my parents.
trans: 我不想让我的父母失望。

name: My boss gave me the whole weekend off.
trans: 我老板给了我整个周末的假。

name: You shouldn't make that assumption so quickly.
trans: 你不该这么快就做出那种假设。

name: Will the lake freeze this winter?
trans: 这个湖今年冬天会结冰吗？

name: This weather is too extreme for a picnic.
trans: 这天气太极端了，不适合野餐。

name: We found a secret passage behind the bookshelf.
trans: 我们在书架后面发现了一条秘密通道。

name: This restaurant has an amazing reputation for pizza.
trans: 这家餐厅的披萨名气很大。

name: The puppy ran back and forth happily.
trans: 小狗开心地来回跑动。

name: The negotiation lasted for three long hours.
trans: 这次谈判持续了漫长的三个小时。

name: This toy has a weird mechanism inside.
trans: 这个玩具里面有个奇怪的机关装置。

name: Put on your coat, it's freezing outside.
trans: 穿上你的外套，外面太冷了。

name: This country has been a democracy for decades.
trans: 这个国家已经是民主国家几十年了。

name: I found a dollar in my pocket!
trans: 我在口袋里发现了一美元！

name: The old car will crash if you drive like that.
trans: 如果你那样开车，这辆旧车会撞坏的。

name: Her observation about the cat was really funny.
trans: 她对那只猫的观察真的很有趣。

name: You need more concentration to win this game.
trans: 你需要更专心才能赢这个游戏。

name: The joke had a deeper implication than we thought.
trans: 这个笑话比我们想的含义更深。

name: You deserve a big slice of cake today.
trans: 你今天应该吃一大块蛋糕。

name: It's unusual for him to wake up early.
trans: 他很少这么早起床，真不寻常。

name: The dog will defend its food from strangers.
trans: 这只狗会保护它的食物不被陌生人抢走。

name: This movie is a classic everyone should watch.
trans: 这部电影是经典，大家都该看看。

name: Their interaction made the whole class laugh.
trans: 他们的互动让全班都笑了。

name: Can you repair my broken phone today?
trans: 你今天能修好我坏掉的手机吗？

name: The tent will collapse if the wind gets stronger.
trans: 如果风变大，帐篷就会倒塌。

name: May I borrow your pen for a minute?
trans: 我可以借用你的笔一分钟吗？

name: Sleep is fundamental for staying healthy.
trans: 睡眠对保持健康是基础的。

name: Wash this dish before you leave, please.
trans: 请在你走之前把这个盘子洗了。

name: She is going abroad next summer for fun.
trans: 她明年夏天要出国玩。

name: My little sister is capable of eating ten cookies.
trans: 我的小妹妹能吃下十块饼干。

name: Our team managed to defeat the strongest rivals.
trans: 我们队成功击败了最强的对手。

name: Her new poster looks very presidential and serious.
trans: 她的新海报看起来非常像总统，很严肃。

name: He sang that song perfectly during the concert.
trans: 他在演唱会上把那首歌唱得完美无瑕。

name: Adding cheese will enhance the taste of pizza.
trans: 加点芝士会提升披萨的味道。

name: My mom was so proud when I won.
trans: 我赢的时候，我妈妈非常自豪。

name: Call 911 now, this is an emergency!
trans: 快打911，这是紧急情况！

name: Is this show educational or just funny?
trans: 这个节目是有教育意义的，还是只是搞笑的？

name: Can you distinguish your shoes from mine?
trans: 你能区分出你的鞋和我的鞋吗？

name: They ate a substantial breakfast before the hike.
trans: 他们徒步前吃了一顿丰盛的早餐。

name: There's a cute puppy store nearby my house.
trans: 我家附近有一家可爱的小狗店。

name: The manufacturer must fix this broken toy soon.
trans: 厂商必须尽快修好这个坏掉的玩具。

name: My kids love to slide down that huge hill.
trans: 我的孩子们喜欢从那座大山坡上滑下来。

name: This necklace is more valuable than my old bike.
trans: 这条项链比我的旧自行车更贵重。

name: Personally, I would never eat spicy noodles.
trans: 就我个人而言，我永远不会吃辣面。

name: We cooked chicken breast for dinner last night.
trans: 我们昨晚晚餐做了鸡胸肉。

name: She learned to cope with her noisy neighbors.
trans: 她学会了应付她那些吵闹的邻居。

name: It takes approximately two hours to bake this cake.
trans: 烤这个蛋糕大约需要两个小时。

name: We found cheap accommodation near the beach.
trans: 我们在海边找到了便宜的住处。

name: Winning the race was the highlight of my week.
trans: 赢得比赛是我这周最精彩的事。

name: The reporter who called me seemed really nice.
trans: 那个给我打电话的记者看起来很友好。

name: This country's climate changes very quickly.
trans: 这个国家的气候变化非常快。

name: My brother spilled juice on his new shirt.
trans: 我弟弟把果汁洒在他的新衬衫上了。

name: Everyone must come, and you are no exception.
trans: 每个人都必须来，你也不例外。

name: That corporation makes more money than our town.
trans: 那家公司赚的钱比我们整个镇子还多。

name: The dog quickly ate a chip off the floor.
trans: 狗很快把地上的一块碎片吃掉了。

name: We had a strange encounter with a goat yesterday.
trans: 我们昨天遇到了一只奇怪的山羊。

name: My puppy has big, soft brown eyes.
trans: 我的小狗有一双棕色的大眼睛。

name: Stop running and breathe for a second.
trans: 别跑了，喘口气吧。

name: Please excuse me, I really need the bathroom.
trans: 请原谅我，我真的需要上厕所。

name: The cake is partly burnt but still tasty.
trans: 蛋糕有点烤焦了，但还是很好吃。

name: Can you play tennis with me tomorrow?
trans: 你明天能和我一起打网球吗？

name: She moved from a farm to an urban area.
trans: 她从农场搬到了城市地区。

trans: 狗正睡在地毯上。

name: A cluster of balloons floated past our window.
trans: 一簇气球飘过我们的窗子。

name: His weird answer caused total confusion.
trans: 他奇怪的回答引起了彻底的困惑。

name: That new rule is really controversial among students.
trans: 那条新规则在学生中很有争议。

name: Can you check my grammar in this sentence?
trans: 你能检查一下这句话的语法吗？

name: I need to revise my essay before tomorrow.
trans: 我得在明天之前修改我的文章。

name: Give me a hint about your birthday present.
trans: 给我一个关于你生日礼物的提示吧。

name: She hung her coat on the hook.
trans: 她把外套挂在钩子上。

name: Is this liquid safe to drink?
trans: 这种液体能安全饮用吗？

name: Don't panic when the lights go out.
trans: 灯灭的时候别惊慌。

name: The ski slope was covered with fresh snow.
trans: 滑雪坡上覆盖着新雪。

name: Puppies bring so much happiness to our house.
trans: 小狗给我们家带来很多快乐。

name: His smile looked completely genuine.
trans: 他的笑容看起来完全真诚。

name: The old vessel sailed slowly across the lake.
trans: 那艘旧船慢慢地驶过湖面。

name: Which word in this sentence is the verb?
trans: 这句话里哪个词是动词？

name: I reckon it will rain tomorrow.
trans: 我估计明天会下雨。

name: Stop being silly and eat your soup.
trans: 别犯傻了，把汤喝了。

name: Buses are the main transportation in this town.
trans: 公共汽车是这个镇上主要的交通工具。

name: The fishing boats rest safely in the harbor.
trans: 渔船安全地停靠在海港里。

name: This comedy made my whole family laugh.
trans: 这部喜剧让我们全家笑个不停。

name: My dog loves to chase the cat.
trans: 我的狗喜欢追那只猫。

name: We need more storage for our toys.
trans: 我们需要更多空间来存放玩具。

name: Is our universe bigger than we think?
trans: 我们的宇宙比我们想的更大吗？

name: The smell from the fridge was horrible.
trans: 冰箱里的味道太可怕了。

name: She painted a portrait of her grandpa.
trans: 她给爷爷画了一幅肖像。

name: The puppy looked innocent after breaking the vase.
trans: 小狗打碎花瓶后看起来很无辜。

name: You can substitute milk with water.
trans: 你可以用水代替牛奶。

name: He takes a vitamin supplement every morning.
trans: 他每天早上吃一种维生素补充剂。

name: Making this adjustment will fix your chair.
trans: 做这个调整会修好你的椅子。

name: The price for lunch was reasonably cheap.
trans: 午饭的价格相当便宜。

name: Filter the water before you drink it.
trans: 喝之前先把水过滤一下。

name: Yoga makes your body more flexible.
trans: 瑜伽让你的身体更柔韧。

name: I don't understand abstract art at all.
trans: 我完全看不懂抽象艺术。

name: We slept in a tent last summer.
trans: 我们去年夏天睡在帐篷里。

name: Give me the precise time, please.
trans: 请告诉我精确的时间。

name: That distant island looks really pretty.
trans: 那个遥远的小岛看起来真美。

name: Don't talk to a stranger alone.
trans: 别和陌生人单独说话。

name: Let's sit in the shade and rest.
trans: 我们坐在阴凉下休息吧。

name: Only one grain of sand got stuck in my shoe.
trans: 只有一粒沙子卡在我鞋子里了。

name: The cabin is situated deep in the forest.
trans: 这间小屋位于森林深处。

name: Try to summarize the story in three words.
trans: 试着用三个词概括这个故事。

name: The dog will leap over the fence tomorrow.
trans: 这只狗明天会跳过那道栅栏。

name: My pencil snapped right before the test.
trans: 我的铅笔在考试前突然断了。

name: The probability of winning is pretty low.
trans: 获胜的可能性相当低。

name: This leather bag feels so soft and nice.
trans: 这个皮包摸起来又软又舒服。

name: Living with uncertainty makes him really nervous.
trans: 活在不确定中让他很紧张。

name: I swear this cake tastes amazing.
trans: 我发誓这块蛋糕好吃极了。

name: The refugee family finally moved into a new home.
trans: 这个难民家庭终于搬进了新家。

name: We built a sandcastle right on the shore.
trans: 我们就在岸边堆了一座沙堡。

name: Grandma visits us on a monthly basis.
trans: 奶奶每月都会来看我们一次。

name: Our club comprises mostly students who love music.
trans: 我们社团主要由喜欢音乐的学生组成。

name: You should stir the pot before it burns.
trans: 你应该在烧焦前搅一搅锅里的东西。

name: Her eyes were full of excitement at the fair.
trans: 她在集市上眼里满是兴奋。

name: Dad let out a huge sigh after work.
trans: 爸爸下班后长长地叹了口气。

name: Her pregnancy went smoothly without any problems.
trans: 她的孕期一切顺利，没有任何问题。

name: This is an experimental dish, so taste it carefully.
trans: 这是一道实验性的菜，你要小心品尝。

name: The school follows strict institutional rules for lunch.
trans: 学校对午餐有严格的制度规定。

name: Kids often wander off at the busy mall.
trans: 孩子们常常在繁忙的商场里走散。

name: This ancient empire covered many countries.
trans: 这个古老的帝国覆盖了许多国家。

name: He was late and subsequently missed the bus.
trans: 他迟到了，随后就错过了公交车。

name: Please be gentle with the kitten.
trans: 对小猫温柔一点。

name: Her attendance at school is perfect.
trans: 她的出勤率非常完美。

name: Who has ownership of this old car?
trans: 这辆旧车的所有权是谁的？

name: You need a qualification to get this job.
trans: 你需要一个资格证才能得到这份工作。

name: They will suspend the game because of rain.
trans: 他们会因为下雨而暂停比赛。

name: This old phone is still functional.
trans: 这部旧手机仍然能用。

name: Joining the club is completely voluntary.
trans: 加入这个俱乐部完全是自愿的。

name: She turned pale after seeing the spider.
trans: 看到蜘蛛后她脸色变得苍白。

name: Don't let the juice stain your shirt.
trans: 别让果汁弄脏你的衬衫。

name: My brother is a famous athlete.
trans: 我哥哥是个有名的运动员。

name: We only buy organic vegetables at the market.
trans: 我们在市场上只买有机蔬菜。

name: The dog's tongue felt warm and wet.
trans: 狗的舌头摸起来又暖又湿。

name: The server crashed right before the game started.
trans: 服务器在游戏开始前崩溃了。

name: Engineers have found structural damage in the bridge.
trans: 工程师们发现这座桥有结构性损坏。

name: I built a website for my dog's photos.
trans: 我为我狗的照片做了一个网站。

name: You can park alongside the house.
trans: 你可以把车停在房子旁边。

name: We should unite to clean up the park.
trans: 我们应该团结起来清理公园。

name: Grandma gently patted the baby to sleep.
trans: 奶奶轻轻拍着宝宝让他睡觉。

name: Can you compute the total price for me?
trans: 你能帮我算一下总价吗？

name: Please wipe the table before we eat.
trans: 吃饭前请把桌子擦一下。

name: This song sounds really weird to me.
trans: 这首歌听起来真的很怪异。

name: She loves to gaze at the stars.
trans: 她喜欢凝视星星。

name: The sunlight will fade by evening.
trans: 阳光到了晚上会渐渐消失。

name: He coughed loudly during the quiet movie.
trans: 他在安静的电影里大声咳嗽。

name: Her hypothesis explains why cats sleep so much.
trans: 她的假设解释了猫为什么睡这么多。

name: Is that man really from a royal family?
trans: 那个人真的是王室出身吗？

name: This plan sounds great, but it's purely theoretical.
trans: 这个计划听起来很棒，但只是理论上的。

name: Could you close the curtain, please?
trans: 你能把窗帘拉上吗？

name: The mayor has promised to fix our roads.
trans: 市长承诺会修好我们的路。

name: The kids were scared of the darkness.
trans: 孩子们害怕黑暗。

name: Our team has won the tournament twice.
trans: 我们队赢过两次锦标赛。

name: I need to finish my registration today.
trans: 我今天得完成注册。

name: I found a fragment of the old vase.
trans: 我找到了一块旧花瓶的碎片。

name: My dog is such a good listener.
trans: 我的狗是个很好的倾听者。

name: Her family came here through immigration long ago.
trans: 她家很久以前通过移民来到这里。

name: The chicken was so tender and juicy.
trans: 鸡肉又嫩又多汁。

name: This rock has a higher density than that one.
trans: 这块石头的密度比那块高。

name: That sweater is the ugliest thing I own.
trans: 那件毛衣是我拥有过最丑的东西。

name: This space module can hold three astronauts.
trans: 这个宇宙飞船舱能容纳三名宇航员。

name: My dog waited faithfully by the door.
trans: 我的狗忠实地在门口等着。

name: Leaves turn orange and red every autumn.
trans: 每到秋天，叶子都会变成橙色和红色。

name: She kissed his cheek before leaving.
trans: 她离开前亲了亲他的脸颊。

name: Did you open the attachment I sent?
trans: 你打开我发的附件了吗？

name: Our new roof uses solar power now.
trans: 我们的新屋顶现在用太阳能了。

name: He started grinning like a silly cat.
trans: 他开始像只傻猫一样露齿笑。

name: Grandma grew a beautiful rose in the yard.
trans: 奶奶在院子里种了一朵漂亮的玫瑰。

name: Can you tell me which word is a noun?
trans: 你能告诉我哪个词是名词吗？

name: We were fortunate to find a parking spot.
trans: 我们很幸运找到了一个停车位。

name: Don't worry, everything will be alright.
trans: 别担心，一切都会好的。

name: His hunger grew after smelling the pizza.
trans: 闻到披萨味后，他更饿了。

name: You should insure your new bike soon.
trans: 你应该尽快给你的新自行车上保险。

name: He felt ashamed after breaking the vase.
trans: 打破花瓶后，他感到很惭愧。

name: Running in the sun gave her terrible thirst.
trans: 在阳光下跑步让她渴得要命。
